answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 16 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The thread multiplier is published, charged in nadir, and voyage lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2578 identities would post 3969 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
